definitions.explanation: The process of making metal objects by melting metal and pouring it into a mold. Used for producing items such as coins, statues, tools, and industrial parts. Can be used as a noun on its own or with する as a verb meaning "to cast" or "to mint."

examples.japanese: ⟦{銅像|どうぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鋳造|ちゅうぞう}。
examples.english: The casting of a bronze statue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鋳造|ちゅうぞう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鉄器|てっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鋳造|ちゅうぞう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At this factory, they cast iron implements using traditional methods.

notes:
Composed of {鋳|ちゅう} (to cast metal) and {造|ぞう} (to make, to build). A technical term belonging to manufacturing, metallurgy, and traditional crafts. It is frequently encountered in contexts involving coin production, bronze statues, temple bells, and industrial metal parts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鋳造|ちゅうぞう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mint coins
- ⟦{銅像|どうぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鋳造|ちゅうぞう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cast a bronze statue
- {鋳造|ちゅうぞう}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: casting technology
- {鋳造|ちゅうぞう}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: a foundry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鋳物|いもの}: cast metal goods — the finished products of {鋳造|ちゅうぞう}
- {鍛造|たんぞう}: forging — shaping hot metal by hammering, a different process
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧: manufacturing — the general term for producing goods
- {成型|せいけい}: molding — shaping materials (often plastics) using a form
